subject: Vendor onboarding call: vendor setup checklist, PO flow, and MAP alignment
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Grant <sophie@bluestack.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding call: vendor setup checklist, PO flow, and MAP alignment

Hi Sophie —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for the pilot. I'd like to schedule a short kickoff (30–45m) to align on vendor setup steps so we can open the PO and complete enrollment. Key goals for the call:

- Confirm the vendor intake form fields and required attachments (W9/SOW/KYC)
- Walk through Redwood's PO process and expected timeline for a standard SOW
- Build a mutual action plan (MAP): owners, milestones, and acceptance criteria
- Identify any security/compliance docs Bluestack will need from us (SOC2, data handling addendum)

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue 4/20 10:00–10:45am
- Tue 4/20 2:00–2:45pm
- Wed 4/21 9:30–10:15am

Please let me know which works best. I've attached our vendor setup form and PO template for your review so we can fill items during the call. If there are any specific procurement contacts from your side who should be on the MAP, add them to your reply.

Attachments: Vendor-Setup-Form.xlsx, Redwood_PO-Template.docx, Procurement-Kickoff-Agenda.md

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
jasmine@redwood.com
[attachment: Vendor-Setup-Form.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]
From: Sophie Grant <sophie@bluestack.io>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
Cc: Bluestack Onboarding <onboarding@bluestack.io>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 13:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding call: vendor setup checklist, PO flow, and MAP alignment

Hi Jasmine —

Thanks for the note and the attachments. Tue 4/20 2:00–2:45pm PST works for our procurement lead and me.

A couple quick items to confirm ahead of the call:
- We have a short security questionnaire we typically run through; can you confirm who on Redwood will own security/compliance follow-up?
- Our standard payment terms are Net45, and we usually need an executed SOW + PO before starting. Will Redwood accept Net45 for this pilot?

I'll loop in our procurement lead if needed — for now I'll book the 2pm slot tentatively.

Best,
Sophie Grant
Head of Partnerships, Bluestack Analytics
sophie@bluestack.io
[signature: Bluestack Analytics | (415) 555-0123]
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Grant <sophie@bluestack.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 08:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding call: vendor setup checklist, PO flow, and MAP alignment

Hi Sophie —

Confirmed for Tue 4/20, 2:00–2:45pm PST. Calendar invite to follow. Quick answers to your notes so we can make the call tactical: 

- Security/compliance owner: Neha will own the questionnaire and follow-ups; expected inputs from Bluestack will be SOC2 report (if available), data flow diagram, and KYC where applicable.
- Payment terms: Karthik is handling the PO path; as a general rule Redwood prefers Net30, but for pilot deals we can evaluate Net45 on a case-by-case basis. Karthik, can you flag any needed approvals if we accept Net45 for a pilot?

On the call we'll run through the Vendor-Setup-Form and the PO template (attached). Proposed MAP (brief):
- Week 0 (kickoff): finalize intake form and list of attachments
- Week 1: legal review + SOW redline
- Week 2: PO issuance and countersign
- Week 3: provisioning & test call

If there are additional stakeholders (finance/legal) please add them to the invite.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

— Jasmine
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>, Sophie Grant <sophie@bluestack.io>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding call: vendor setup checklist, PO flow, and MAP alignment

Hi all —

Joining shortly; confirmed we can discuss Net45 for the pilot but will need manager approval for exceptions to standard Net30. I'll own the PO issuance and internal approvals (Finance escalation if needed). Neha will take Security/compliance follow-ups and own delivering any evidence (SOC2, DPIA).

Quick notes for the kickoff agenda (to keep the call focused):
1) Opening (5m) — introductions and success criteria (Sophie/Jasmine)
2) Vendor intake review (10m) — walk Vendor-Setup-Form and required attachments
3) PO & SOW path (10m) — timeline and approvers; Net45 discussion and contingency
4) Security/compliance checklist (10m) — Neha to list required docs and timing
5) Next steps & owners (5m) — confirm MAP items and calendar milestones

I'll attach the PO checklist after the call. See you at 2pm PST.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Procurement Operations, Redwood Inference
